directive.exactGatingQuestion: Can the live PL packet's unresolved_gating_issue and unresolved_gating_unknown be resolved by primary-source corroboration of the September 3, 2026 Q2 FY2027 company-release claims that Scout observed only through a syndicated copy?
directive.whyItMatters: These are the only current Deep Resolver-owned failures. The packet explicitly says the primary-hosted Planet IR copy was not retrieved and requires SEC/IR corroboration before the syndicated release can be relied upon as gated evidence.
directive.preferredPrimarySource: SEC EDGAR Planet Labs PBC CIK 0001836833: September 3, 2026 Form 8-K accession 0001193125-26-381874 with Exhibit 99.1, plus same-day Form 10-Q accession 0001193125-26-382016.
lawfulFallbacks: Planet Labs investor-relations events/presentations page for the Q2 FY2027 earnings event
Planet-hosted investor relations release if directly retrievable
directive.successCondition: Verify from primary SEC/issuer material that Planet itself issued the September 3 Q2 FY2027 results and that the core syndicated claims used by Scout are traceable to that primary release; preserve valuation as a separate Alpha-owned task rather than inventing a canonical valuation conclusion.

items.finding: SEC EDGAR independently supplies the missing primary lineage. Planet Labs PBC filed a Form 8-K dated September 3, 2026 under CIK 0001836833 stating that it issued a press release announcing financial results for the second fiscal quarter ended July 31, 2026 and attached that release as Exhibit 99.1. The SEC-hosted Exhibit 99.1 is titled 'Planet Reports Financial Results for Second Quarter of Fiscal Year 2027' and reports record quarterly revenue of $116 million, up 58% year over year, alongside the same operating/cash highlights represented in the syndicated Scout source. Planet also filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 the same day. This directly cures the packet's exact primary_source_corroboration_required defect without relying on the syndicated host as authority.
items.gateImpact: The unresolved primary_source_corroboration_required gating issue is resolved. Deterministic recompilation should treat the SEC 8-K/Exhibit 99.1/10-Q lineage as primary-source evidence rather than leaving this Deep Resolver gate open.

items.finding: The packet's first gating unknown—absence of a primary-hosted copy—is cured by the SEC-hosted 8-K, Exhibit 99.1 and 10-Q. Its second wording says no canonical valuation conclusion is made because primary-source corroboration remained required. The causal prerequisite named in that unknown is now satisfied. This resolution does not manufacture a valuation conclusion: marketValuationOpportunity, numeric scoring, score-risk evidence and Data Confidence remain separately routed to council-alpha and are outside this Deep Resolver directive.
items.gateImpact: The Deep Resolver-owned unresolved_gating_unknown should clear on recompilation. Any still-missing valuation/factor/score/confidence evidence remains an Alpha-owned preflight failure and must not be interpreted as resolved by this object.
